name: automation
description: Devices, readings, queues and rules: sensors, buttons and switches over MQTT, each reading kept as history and published on routing keys for queues and logs to take

nodeTypes.label: Device
nodeTypes.description: Something in the house that reports or can be switched: a sensor, a plug, a button. Holds one entity per reading or control, and comes and goes with its source (MQTT discovery, Shelly).

nodeTypes.label: Entity
nodeTypes.description: One reading or control of a device: a temperature, a relay, a button. Holds its history (a log), its live readings (a router publishing on automation.state|event.<device>.<entity>) and, when it can be set, its set node.

nodeTypes.label: Device command
nodeTypes.description: Where device-set writes what an entity is asked to be; its mode says who may switch the entity.

options.label: MQTT broker
options.description: The broker devices talk to, as mqtt://host:1883 or mqtts://host:8883. setup.sh --mqtt runs one beside EiN and sets this.
options.emptyMeans: automation is off: no device is heard

options.label: MQTT user
options.description: The account EiN signs in to the broker with.
options.emptyMeans: EiN signs in without an account

options.label: MQTT password
options.description: The password of the MQTT user, sent only to the broker above. No shell sees it, and nothing shows it once it is set.

options.label: Device sources
options.description: Which kinds of device the bridge listens for, separated by spaces: ha-discovery (anything that announces itself the way Home Assistant reads, such as ESPHome) and shelly (Shelly's second generation and later).

options.label: Discovery prefix
options.description: The topic devices announce themselves under, for ha-discovery.

options.label: Reading history
options.description: How long an entity's readings are kept. Applies to entities found from now on; an entity found before keeps its own (change it with attrs on its history).

options.label: Seconds between readings
options.description: The shortest time between two readings of one entity that are kept and published. A reading that comes sooner waits, and only the newest of those is kept. On and off, words and presses are kept as they come. An entity's own minInterval attr overrides it.
